CHARACTER INTRODUCTION

Joseph Harrison is a genius student at Bright Future School, being a great leader and a very charismatic and friendly person, being in the future husband of Emma Elliot Wilson, the main character of the verse, Joseph Harrison is an original character created by me @Hypervenomxtreme, I do not plan to give this doc to anyone and I am only doing it for my own entertainment.
IMPORTANT THINGS ABOUT THE STORY

Red9: terrorist organization led by Amelia Elliot Wilson and her 2 vice leaders that has control over more than 5,000 terrorist gangs around the world and whose ideology is to kill all “sinners” in order to achieve divine salvation. After confirmation from Index that the creator would destroy the universe (which is a lie, but there was no way they could have known that), several religions around the world collapsed, after all the god they admired and worshiped would exterminate them in the future. Red9 decided to sacrifice the sinners so that their lives would be spared.

Sinners: Billionaires, corrupt politicians or non-corrupt politicians (the mere fact that they are politicians makes them sinners in Red9’s eyes), international celebrities and criminals who, no matter how minor their crimes were, will end up dead at the hands of Red9.

My interpretation of what is strategy
A plan composed of Multiple tactics that can be both Long term or short term and has the sole purpose of achieving success or an advantage to the one who made the strategy.
My interpretation of what is planning:

A plan composed of Multiple strategies set at different moments to achieve a specific outcome or a plan made by indirect means without the direct intervention of the planner The Death note memory loss plan is a good example of this as Light just prepares everything for his planning and doesn't interfere directly in it after the start of the plan.

At the age of 13, Joseph was already studying subjects at university level, was able to solve the most complex puzzles with ease and could speak more than 5 different languages ​​such as Russian, German, French, English and Korean.
(Academics, VSI, VCI, Crystallized intelligence, linguistic intelligence)

At a special event at the school that Joseph attended, an event was taking place. At a certain point, he was able to take a tablet from one of the event organizers without him noticing and took a look at one of the files on the tablet. It contained basic information about all 305 people who were going to participate in the event, the employees who were going to organize it, and an aerial map of the location that was in 2D. There were things like: names, employment, age, criminal record, other family members, financial status, address, weight, and height. Without any difficulty, Joseph reads, processes, and stores in his mind all the content contained in that document in 5 seconds while at the same time transforming the aerial map that was in 2D into a 3D copy of the location inside his mind. After reading everything, he puts the tablet back and leaves as if nothing had happened. The 3D copy of the map that Joseph saw on the tablet was of the gymnasium where the event was taking place, which has an exact total area of ​​3.2 square kilometers.
(PSI, WMI, VSI, PRI, CPI, TRI, Multi tasking, visual spatial intelligence)
The Cultists of Outer Realm:

While he was still 14 years old, Joseph walks back to his house with his childhood friend, Ellie. On the way back home, Joseph notices a commotion happening in front of the place and quickly hides with Ellie. He observes what was happening and realizes that it was a religious cult. Joseph and Ellie leave after seeing that and walk back home avoiding the religious cult.  The next day, the city where Joseph lives wakes up with a big surprise waiting for them. On the asphalt of the street where he lives there was a large pool of blood. Joseph immediately understood that this was the work of the cultists he saw yesterday. He feels a sense of sadness over the death of those people and decides that he will deal with them on his own. Joseph prepares a situation to deal with the cultists. At night, the cultists return to the same neighborhood and look for victims that they can kill. One of the cultists sees a house with the lights on and thinks that someone must still be awake. The cultist notices that the window at the back of the house is open and breaks into the place. Upon entering the place, the cultist does not notice anything wrong and continues to walk around the place. Until he smells a strong smell and out of nowhere the entire house is taken over by a sleeping gas. Joseph had prepared a trap with a line on the kitchen door. If someone opened the door from the inside, the line connected to the door would make a specific chemical element mix with another chemical element. The mixture of these two would create a kind of sleeping gas. Joseph  was hiding in the fake dog house that he made in an improvised way (it was night which would make it difficult for the cultists to see the house and even if they did the chances of the cultists investigating the dog house were very low) upon realizing that the cultist had fallen into the trap, Joseph moved away from the place, took a lighter and threw it inside the house, the fire from the lighter in combination with the sleeping gas, caused a large-scale explosion that was intended to draw the attention of the cultists and the police as well as the neighbors and people who lived near the place, the cultists realizing such danger decided to run away without worrying about their surroundings, in their haste to escape the place, The cultists are caught by surprise when 6 of their 14 remaining members (excluding the one who was killed by Joseph) have their legs almost completely cut off. Joseph had prepared a sharp line trap. The trap is connected to two posts that are on opposite sides of the street. Before blowing up the house, only one of the lines was connected to a post, while the other was lying on the ground and being held by a nail. In other words, anyone could pass through the two posts and nothing would happen (at least during that period). Before blowing up the house, Joseph went to the house next door, going over the fence. At the neighbor's house, he found the nail that held the thin line. After finding it, he threw the lighter and blew up the house. After blowing it up, Joseph took the side of the line that was not yet connected to one of the posts and connected it to the post as he had planned. The cultists were confused because they had come from that exact direction and there was no sharp line there when they arrived. Their leader then came to the conclusion that someone was setting them up.  However, they couldn't worry about that for now, after all, the neighbors who were close to the explosion were starting to wake up thanks to the noise, the cultists abandoned those who were injured by the trap and decided to continue down a straight alley (that street had 3 paths they could walk on, one of the paths had a sharp line that could easily kill them, the chance of the other street also having a line was very high, however the alley the cultists were going to walk down didn't have any nearby poles or any kind of support to connect the lines, that is, there was zero chance of there being a sharp line there), they walked desperately down the alley exactly as Joseph planned, until they were caught by surprise by several blue and red lights, the place was very bright thanks to the intensity of the lights, the cultists seeing the blue and red colors believed that the light came from police cars, this idea became even more evident to them when they heard a deep voice saying "stop!!"  It's the police, you will be arrested for murder and terrorism!” Upon hearing this the cultists stood firm and said they would not bow to the “unholy laws” of the police, however they quickly changed their minds when they heard gunshots, after hearing the gunshots they quickly bowed down and begged for mercy, before they knew it their surroundings were already being covered in sleeping gas, upon waking they were being surrounded by police and were immediately arrested.  The blue and red lights that the cultists thought were the police were actually just flashing blue and red lights prepared by Joseph. He purposely increased the intensity of the light to make sure the cultists thought it was really the police. In addition, he had prepared a voice recorder with an audio that he had already prepared. After the cultists went down the alley as Joseph planned, he activated the lights and after a few seconds, he activated the audio. Joseph had left a voice recorder the day he saw the cultists for the first time, that is, when he was with his childhood friend. He left the voice recorder there and the next day Joseoh took the recorder back and listened to what the cultists were saying. Just by listening to them speak, he already understood their personality perfectly and so he predicted that the cultists would oppose the “unholy laws” of the police. All the actions that the cultists did after meeting the “police” were predicted by Joseph. He approached the place  when he realized that the cultists took the bait, he released a sleeping gas in the place and ran away, the voices of what the cultists believed to be the police were actually Joseph's modified voice, the gunshot noises were noises that he modified too, that's how he dealt with the cultists from "outer realm" (that's what Joseph named them), besides that the house that Joseph blew up was one of the extra houses that his family owned, Joseph's parents are rich and own several houses of many different types, there was no one else inside that house besides the cultist who broke into it, Joseph's parents can easily buy a new house just like that one, in case the cultists aren't scared of the gunshot noises as Joseph had predicted, He had placed a line connected to a closed bucket containing a large amount of sleeping gas. If the cultists tried to approach the "police" they would end up stepping on the line and the sleeping gas would fall on them, leaving them completely incapacitated. Even if they somehow avoided the line, whether by pure luck or any other reason, the cultists who had been left behind thanks to the sharp line trap could be interrogated by the police to find out information about the other members of the outer realm cult and inevitably capture them.

Joseph enters Bright Future School, a school full of genius students and prodigies in certain areas of knowledge. On the first day, Joseph stands out and makes several friends easily thanks to his charisma, intelligence and sense of responsibility. In just 2 days, he makes friends with almost half of all the students in the school, including the students in the reserve classes who are known for being quite quarrelsome and hateful.

First Year Special Event:

Joseph and several other students will participate in their first event at Bright Future School, the members of Joseph's 1-D class enter the chamber where the event will begin first and Joseph follows them into the chamber, upon arriving there he enters one of the capsules and his consciousness is sent into the virtual reality machine.  Joseph wakes up inside a place that looks like a classroom and tries to remember where he was or what he was doing before he ended up in that place, however no matter how hard he tries, Joseph cannot remember what happened thanks to the virtual reality machine's ability to manipulate and temporarily erase memories, confused and with no idea of ​​what is happening Joseph gets up from the chair he was sitting in and heads towards the door of the classroom where he was, however before opening the door he hears noises 16 meters away from a maximum of 2 people, Joseph uses his hearing to try to hear what the two people were saying, he listens to their conversation and realizes that they are as confused about that situation as he is currently, Joseph then decides to open the door and on the other side were two black-haired girls, upon seeing Joseph they despair and hold a piece of doorknob that they found on the floor because they had broken down the door of the classroom where they were, even though he is able to deal with the two without difficulty, Joseph tries to calm them down and says that he is in the same situation as them, the girls still  Suspicious, they order him to walk in front of the path and they would follow him from behind, that way they could immobilize him if Joseph tries anything. Realizing the dangers of accepting this proposal, Joseph is hesitant, but after a while he agrees to the two girls' conditions. Joseph and the girls walk straight down a dark path. Joseph tells jokes and funny things about himself to the girls in order to create bonds of friendship and trust. Joseph knew that those girls had nothing to do with what was happening thanks to the conversation he heard at the doorknob and because he looked at the girls' faces and understood that someone with the same personalities as them would not be capable of such a thing. Joseph continues walking down the dark path until he comes face to face with a group of 13 people (16 counting Joseph and the two girls), Joseph approaches the group with the girls and introduces himself to everyone. He asks if anyone has any idea what the hell is going on. However, everyone says they don't know anything. Joseph looks at the two girls who still have the doorknob they came from pointed at his head and politely asks them to lower their guns. The girls obviously refuse and Joseph says that now that there are more than 15 people in that place, they no longer have any reason to fear that he will end up attacking them in any way or doing something to harm them. Realizing this, the girl who had the doorknob in her hands moves away from Joseph, who thanks him. Realizing the distance and lack of trust that the people present at the place had towards each other, Joseph calls everyone's attention and clarifies the situation by saying, "Honestly, I'm no expert in this kind of thing (lie), but even I can easily recognize that suspecting each other now will only make our deaths inevitable. I understand that you are scared and being cautious for your own safety.  of you, but at this very moment, staying united is our only chance to escape”, upon hearing this, some of the people present decide to introduce themselves, including Joseph. The girls who came with Joseph agree with his idea because they no longer consider him a suspicious person. After all, if he was the one responsible for putting them there, he would not put his own life at risk and would definitely deny the girls’ request to go first. However, what Joseph did was exactly the opposite. He put his life at risk even without being sure if the girls would attack him, even without knowing if he was the mastermind or not. Joseph had already predicted that the girls would trust him after that and that is why he accepted their proposal so calmly. Seeing that everyone was calmly introducing themselves and strengthening their bonds of trust, the people who were still suspicious began to introduce themselves as well. After everyone had introduced themselves, Joseph suggested that the best thing to do now would be to investigate the place and try to find out something. However, before he could finish speaking, a distorted voice was heard coming from a large monitor attached to the wall. From the monitor on the wall, a pixelated teddy bear appeared.  The being that appeared on the monitor was ridiculously cute. Joseph quickly deduced that the people who had trapped them there were trying to make them lower their guard. He warns the other people in the place about this, who become tense and fearful. After a while, the teddy bear begins to speak, “Hello participants, I am ‘Honey’ the friendly bear. You are all here to play a small, innocent game with me for an indefinite amount of time.” After hearing the “indefinite amount of time” part, Joseph immediately understood that he and the other people who were in the place would be trapped there for the rest of their lives. Joseph already foresees that if he reveals this to the other participants, they could end up going completely crazy. Joseph has always had a strong sense of responsibility for those close to him since childhood, something like a “leader complex.” However, before he could finish his thoughts, Joseph hears a voice screaming. One of the girls who had followed Joseph realized what the teddy bear meant by “indefinite amount of time.” She came to the conclusion that they would all be trapped there forever, Upon hearing that they would be trapped in that place, everyone in the place became desperate and started shouting at each other. Some started to revolt and accuse each other. The rest seemed to have become something similar to a beast that acted entirely on survival instinct. Joseph quickly tried to calm everyone down. However, as he had already predicted, no one listened to him. It was expected. After all, they were all in a situation that was completely unknown to them, and they didn't know if they would live or die. Now they received the news that they would be in that place forever. Joseph, realizing the situation, made a difficult decision. He grabbed the doorknob that the girl who had followed him still had in her hands and attacked her in front of everyone. Upon realizing this, the participants quickly attacked him and knocked him out. Thanks to what had just happened, the relationship of trust and unity that the students had with each other would last a little longer. Joseph did this on purpose to draw the participants' attention away from the fact that they would be trapped in that place, even if only for a few seconds. Unfortunately, he would be seen as an enemy from now on and would hardly be able to  they would trust him, this was merely a temporary solution, however it was the best he could do for now, after a while Joseph wakes up and immediately realizes that he is bound by chains, both his hands and his torso are completely restrained, he looks ahead and sees all the participants around him, talking to each other, after a while, one of the participants notices that Joseph has woken up and calls everyone over there, the participants are now facing Joseph, some are scared, some are still having difficulty processing the whole situation and on the faces of the remaining participants can only be seen pure and ultimate hatred, just a few mere seconds after they were gathered, one of the participants advances towards Joseph and kicks him hard in the face, even after this he maintains his act that he is an enemy of the participants, after taking another kick from the same person Joseph looks at the participant who kicked him and says "is that all?  How ridiculous, if it's information you want you'll have to try harder than that", after hearing this the participant who was kicking him starts to attack him with his fists, punching him quite hard and even after that Joseph continues to act like a villain, the other participants realizing that the person who was beating Joseph was exaggerating too much quickly stop him, they look at Joseph with judgmental looks and say that if he says something useful they will let him go, Joseph starts to laugh and says "that's a lie... and honestly it's a pretty bad one, letting me go just because I gave you a little bit of information is pure stupidity, you're not going to let me go and that's completely obvious, the next time you try to get information out of someone, come up with something more convincing", hearing Joseph ridicule them, the rest of the participants start to violently attack him, taking out all their anguish, anger and fear on Joseph, however they are quickly stopped by bullets coming from the ceiling that hit the leg of one of the participants who starts to scream in pain, a nearby monitor  He calls and Honey the teddy bear appears and says that the main game is about to begin. Joseph, who was pretending to be unconscious, remains quiet so he can hear everything. Honey frees Joseph and orders all participants to go to the game room (including the participant who was shot in the leg). Fearing that they will be targeted by the weapons, the participants go to the room as promised, keeping a high distance from Joseph. They arrive at the location and sit in 16 chairs, each containing a picture of the participants to make it clear where each one should sit. The players will play a game called "The Torch of Destiny", and now the rules for this game will be revealed.

Players will start the game with a total of 3 special cards. These cards counter each other and the 16 players must advance in 1VS1 confrontations with each other until there are only 8 participants left to continue in the game. These 8 participants will fight each other in a confrontation and those players who emerge victorious from the game will be “eliminated.” Basically, this is a game in which the participants must lose. The 4 unlucky players who win the game and defeat their opponents will be punished with death. This is a game where the roles are reversed, a game where to win, you must lose.  The Blind Lady of Justice card is able to counter the Great King of Chaos card, the Great King of Chaos card is able to counter the Supreme Peacemaker card and the Supreme Peacemaker card can counter the Blind Lady of Justice card, if the players take identical cards that do not counter each other like the Supreme Peacemaker and another Supreme Peacemaker, the game will repeat 3 times until one of the players takes a card that is able to counter the opponent's card.

The game will have a total of 3 rounds, if a tie occurs in all 3 rounds of the main game both two players who are confronting each other will survive and thus the number of people who will die will be reduced to 3, if a tie occurs with all players then the game will end without any casualties, however something like this is practically impossible, the death of someone in this game is practically inevitable.

Revealing each other's cards to opponents is completely forbidden and if something like this ends up being discovered by Honey, the main game organizer, the rule-breaker will be killed. Furthermore, when using a card, such as the peacemaker card, if both players use the peacemaker card, that card cannot be used again by the players and they will have to use any other card other than the peacemaker card.

After hearing the rules, the players are terrified of the possibility of dying, including Joseph who, despite being scared, maintains his antagonistic role. After a while, the players who will face each other are decided and Joseph is placed against one of the girls who had followed him at the beginning, more precisely, the girl he hit with the doorknob. Joseph keeps a serious look on his face as he looks at the girl and realizes that she was afraid of him. He had already expected this, after all, he hit her with a doorknob from behind and completely betrayed the trust she had in him. After this, Joseph says that the girl would use the Lady of Justice card. This was merely a guess on his part. The Lady of Justice card is the card with the greatest chance of being used by the girl. After all, she was purposely avoiding looking at her. The girl reacts to this but quickly hides her emotions. In addition, her reaction to Joseph's guess  It was quite light, when realizing all this he comes to the conclusion that the girl's card was most likely not that of the Lady of Justice, however going completely against his logical deduction, Joseph chooses the Lady of Justice card and the girl also chooses the same card, the girl's light reaction was on purpose to cause suspicion in Joseph and deceive him into thinking that her card was not that of the Lady of Justice, Joseph had already predicted this action of the girl at the moment the opponents were announced, upon witnessing the tie the girl became curious and restless about something, if Joseph had already realized her lie, then why didn't he choose the Peacemaker card that would cause an instant defeat in her? He could easily cause her death if he so wished, this question caused several thoughts in her mind and after thinking for a while, the girl thinks about the possibility that Joseph is actually an ally, all the rounds that occur after that one end in a tie because both players use the same card, Joseph was easily reading the girl's emotions and predicting which cards she would use, so the girl
